name: Write Canary File to C Drive
description: Writes a simple text file to the C:\ drive of the computer.  Requires SYSTEM level execution context to work.
script:
# Define the file path
$filePath = "C:\Canary.txt"

# Write some content into the file
$env:canaryMessage | Out-File -FilePath $filePath -Encoding UTF8

variables.name: canaryMessage
variables.label: Canary Message
variables.description: This is the text that will be written into the canary file.
